task: Independent evidence-quality challenge of worker-native-results.json and worker-backend_operations-results.json

spot_checks.claim: Canonical state requires target location, own assignee or genuinely claimable QUEUED/unassigned task, and matching session/task version.
source_evidence: employee-parking-start-recovery.ts:54-63 filters PARKING + target session + optional known task
employee-parking-start-recovery.ts:66-96 treats QUEUED + null assignee as local claimable candidate and requires session.locationId target plus session.version == task.valetSessionVersion
employee-parking-start-recovery.ts:99-109 separately fences identity/org/membership/location/shift
spot_checks.assessment: The control flow is correctly summarized, but 'genuinely claimable' overstates client authority. This helper only classifies QUEUED/unassigned as a local candidate; it does not prove backend eligibility or claim authority.
spot_checks.recommended_text: Canonical classification accepts the current assignee or a locally candidate QUEUED/unassigned task; backend authority remains decisive.

spot_checks.claim: Release result ... end physical session and task as COMPLETED ... before publishing released state.
source_evidence: employee-release-flow-command.ts:6-27 validates exact session/task IDs, +1 versions, session state COMPLETED, taskStatus COMPLETED, retrievalRequestStatus COMPLETED
employee-release-flow-command.ts:30-50 publishes phase released and clears local task
spot_checks.assessment: The file validates server response fields only. 'End physical session' can be read as proof of physical handover/custody completion, which this client reducer cannot establish.
spot_checks.recommended_text: Requires the authoritative response to report session/task/retrieval request COMPLETED before publishing local released state.

spot_checks.claim: Recovery binds operationId and exact END presence target including authority/cash; committed output is revalidated; denied/expired/not-sent requires fresh exact authority context before a new attempt.
source_evidence: employee-shift-end-recovery.ts:30-45 checks operationId and presenceTargetKey(endPresenceTarget(authority,cashReported))
employee-shift-end-recovery.ts:46-57 calls validateEmployeeShiftEndResult before ended
employee-shift-end-recovery.ts:59-85 reloads operational context and compares employeeShiftEndAuthorityKey before returning active/error
spot_checks.assessment: Claim is bounded and source-supported. The draft correctly preserves runtime/server limitations.

spot_checks.claim: Pending exceptions are read and verified against target/challenge.
source_evidence: employee-shift-presence-recovery.ts:93-109 reads exception, verifies exception against target, then reads/verifies challenge only if not already present
employee-shift-presence-workflow.ts:90-100 verifyException checks action/locationId/shiftId only
shift-presence-public.ts:153-167 exception response has no challengeId field
spot_checks.assessment: Target binding and challenge verification both exist, but the exception response is not directly correlated to a challenge ID by this client code. 'Verified against target/challenge' is too strong.
spot_checks.recommended_text: Pending exceptions are verified against the exact target; challenge guidance is separately read/verified against the operation descriptor.

spot_checks.claim: Storage mutation queue prevents stale delete/purge from overwriting a fresh prepared marker.
source_evidence: incident-recovery-state.ts:42-43 owns a per-instance storageTail
incident-recovery-state.ts:154-173 serializes clearResolved/purge/prepare operations through that instance tail
incident-recovery-state.ts:200-210 binds restored marker context
native-incident-session.ts:144-150 confirms prepare completes before reserve in the production Native caller
spot_checks.assessment: The serialization guarantee is real only within one IncidentRecoveryState instance. The draft wording sounds store-global and should be bounded; cross-instance/store races are not excluded by storageTail itself.
spot_checks.recommended_text: The per-instance storage queue serializes marker mutations within one IncidentRecoveryState; caller generation/store behavior remains relevant to cross-instance races.

spot_checks.claim: Uses crypto.getRandomValues only, preserves 122 random bits, forces UUIDv8 version/RFC variant, lower-case formats, and has no insecure entropy fallback.
source_evidence: incident-recovery-id.ts:3-10 requires getRandomValues and throws if unavailable
incident-recovery-id.ts:10-12 starts with 128 random bits and overwrites exactly 6 version/variant bits
incident-recovery-id.ts:13-21 lower-case hex formats and schema-validates UUIDv8

spot_checks.claim: FOR SHARE on organizations/locations is compatible with restricted runtime because provisioning grants SELECT plus UPDATE(updated_at).
source_evidence: financial-policy-resolver.ts:22-50 uses FOR SHARE OF organization, location and requires exactly one scope row
runtime-table-privileges.mjs:19-32 includes organizations/locations in read-only SELECT set
runtime-table-privileges.mjs:117-127 and 221-226 grant column-level UPDATE(updated_at) as lock privilege
basic-branding-runtime-privilege.integration.test.ts:113-126 expects generic table-level UPDATE to remain false
spot_checks.assessment: The draft is materially correct. Clarify that UPDATE is column-level only; generic table UPDATE is deliberately denied. This makes the lock-compatibility explanation stronger and avoids implying broader write authority.
spot_checks.recommended_text: Provisioning grants SELECT plus narrow column-level UPDATE(updated_at) needed for row locking while generic table UPDATE remains denied.

spot_checks.claim: Any cash entry, provider event, or durable collection operation counts as collection evidence, so even incomplete/failed collection attempts freeze mutable financial terms.
source_evidence: payment-mutation-repository.ts:109-127 checks EXISTS across cash_entries, payment_provider_events, payment_collection_operations without terminal-state filtering
payment-mutation-guards.ts:7-19 treats that evidence as COLLECTION_ALREADY_STARTED
spot_checks.assessment: Source supports the conservative freeze claim. No finding is implied.

spot_checks.claim: Guest tip re-resolves/locks guest credential in transaction; invalid access is counted, valid domain rejection/success ignored for anti-abuse; cancelled/revoked legacy guest access is denied by resolver.
source_evidence: payment-mutation.service.ts:153-187 resolves/locks credential, COUNTED on undefined, IGNORED on success or FinancialMutationError
guest-access.service.ts:74-100 delegates legacy credential to resolveAndLockGuestAccessSession and converts GuestAccessError to undefined
guest-access-session-resolution.ts:58-75 rejects CANCELLED, consumed, revoked, expired and stale completed access
spot_checks.assessment: Claim is supported, with the draft already disclosing that GuestAccessService is a separate ownership dependency.

spot_checks.claim: Authorized projection locks session/payment for stable read and computes fail-closed release satisfaction; with no payment, release is satisfied only when policy does not require payment.
source_evidence: payment-projection-query.ts:50-81 takes session FOR SHARE, resolves policy, and no-payment returns releaseSatisfied=!releaseRequiresPayment
payment-projection-query.ts:63-130 payment is exact org/location/session scoped and internal provider/reference only feed isPaymentReleaseSatisfied
payment-release-satisfaction.ts:19-55 fails closed for malformed/incoherent NOT_REQUIRED/PAID states
spot_checks.assessment: Claim is supported. Preserve the draft limit that the initial session FOR SHARE row count is not checked in this helper and relies on prior authorization/resolution in the same transaction.

spot_checks.claim: A positive DIGITAL_ONLY policy fails because this baseline has no configured digital initiation path.
source_evidence: payment-recompute.ts:30-40 unconditionally throws DIGITAL_PAYMENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE for positive DIGITAL_ONLY without consulting a provider registry
payments.module.ts:31-37 separately binds DigitalPaymentProviderRegistry to UnconfiguredDigitalPaymentProviderRegistry
digital-payment-provider.ts:42-50 confirms that registry returns null for provider selection
spot_checks.assessment: The baseline fact about an unconfigured registry is true, but the causal statement is too strong for this function: recompute rejects DIGITAL_ONLY directly regardless of registry state.
spot_checks.recommended_text: For positive due, recomputePayment directly rejects DIGITAL_ONLY; separately, this baseline wires an unconfigured digital provider registry.

spot_checks.claim: Collection reconciliation is scoped/provider/reference/amount/state fenced, transitions operation/payment atomically, prevents reordered failure downgrade, and reference uniqueness/collision retry handles races.
source_evidence: provider-event-collection.ts:60-136 resolves within authenticated organization, locks related rows, checks state/provider/reference/currency/amount/payment compatibility and reference ownership
provider-event-collection.ts:137-179 CASes operation to RESOLVED then guarded payment to PAID/FAILED; failed payment update throws inside transaction
provider-event-ingress.ts:104-132 retries recognized provider-reference unique collisions once and 150-159 handles duplicate event-id uniqueness
migrations 010/011/028 define the named payment/provider-event/collection-operation unique indexes
spot_checks.assessment: Core record is correct. The race-handling sentence depends on provider-event-ingress plus DB uniqueness rather than this file alone; keep those dependencies explicit. The separate claim that a definitive FAILED payment permits a fresh collection is also supported by digital-collection-command.ts:68-86, which allows UNPAID or FAILED subject to fresh evidence/policy guards.

summary.overall: Evidence drafts are structurally sound and source-hash accurate. Most semantic claims are supported, but five wording corrections are recommended to avoid overstating client authority, physical proof, exception-to-challenge correlation, storage-global serialization, or DIGITAL_ONLY causality.
